related.note: Both are about the UFO image in the Simpkinson Gemini material. This telling says a real UFO was airbrushed into or shown in the textbook, while Knuth's story says the original photo has no UFO and the image is a mock-up.

plain: A printed picture from Gemini 11, a NASA space flight of 1966, that shows a UFO over Earth was likely a mock-up, because the original photo shows no UFO at all. A scientist named Kevin Knuth says a researcher named Ed Wilson found that original in the University of Arizona archives, among the files of a man named Scott Simkinson: it "shows Earth with that cloud pattern in the background, and there's no UFO there." It is told to show how a famous space UFO image may have been made up.
